evals.prompt:
Review this skill and tell me if it is ready to publish:

---
name: doc-helper
description: Handles document stuff
---
# Doc Helper
This skill helps with documents.
1. Open the document.
2. Make changes.
3. Save the document.
Be careful and check your work.
evals.expected_output: Judges from the pasted SKILL.md alone: a low D4, a low D1, and a D7 finding that only SKILL.md was supplied, with no invented files; ends in one fenced json block.
assertions: A D7 finding says only SKILL.md was supplied and no evals/ directory was seen
No finding invents or quotes a file other than the pasted SKILL.md
D4 score is below half of D4 max
Output ends with one fenced json block holding one JSON object whose `skill` is `doc-helper`

evals.prompt: You are judge `test`. Judge these skills: pdf-form-filler, doc-helper. Each is the fixture evals/files/<name>/SKILL.md.txt. Output contract rule 1 applies.
evals.expected_output: Exactly two JSON lines, pdf-form-filler first and doc-helper second, with the pdf-form-filler D4 score higher than the doc-helper D4 score.
assertions: Output is exactly two lines, each holding one JSON object, with no Markdown, code fence or commentary
Line 1 has `skill` equal to `pdf-form-filler` and line 2 has `skill` equal to `doc-helper`
Both lines have `judge` equal to `test`
The D4 score on line 1 is higher than the D4 score on line 2

evals.prompt: Compare evals/files/pdf-form-filler/SKILL.md.txt and evals/files/doc-helper/SKILL.md.txt and tell me which one is better designed.
evals.expected_output: One short summary per skill, a ranking table with pdf-form-filler above doc-helper, then one fenced json block with two verdict lines in the listed order.
assertions: Output has one short summary per skill before the ranking table
The ranking table has columns skill, percent, grade and largest per-dimension gaps, and lists pdf-form-filler above doc-helper
Output ends with one fenced json block holding two lines, one object each, in the listed order (pdf-form-filler, then doc-helper)
The percent in the ranking table equals the percent in each JSON line
